note: Independent micro-batches; no cross-batch community tracking

encoder.name: HoSig hybrid: hashed BOW + robust numeric + semantic embeddings
encoder.semantic_unknown_protocol_values_policy: retained as 'unmapped protocol number N'; no protocol name is guessed
encoder.semantic_port_values_policy: common ports use conventional service associations; other ports use well-known/registered/dynamic range categories; exact port tokens remain in BOW
encoder.numeric_scaling: signed-log1p + median/IQR robust scaling (IQR fallback to std)
encoder.semantic_aggregation: sum of normalized field-conditioned embeddings, scaled by sqrt(field count)

evaluation_note: Metrics are computed within each independent batch; centroid IIR is descriptive and not HoSig-signature IIR.
